title.zh: 由Bybit前联席CEO创立的美国加密交易所ABFinance暂停运营
title.en: ABFinance, Ex-Bybit Co-CEO's U.S. Exchange, Suspends Operations

summary.zh: 由Bybit前联席CEO Helen Liu创立的美国加密交易所ABFinance已于2025年8月14日暂停运营，原因是美国监管压力。该平台原本计划整合存款、交易、理财和支付功能，但暂停的范围和时间表尚未公布。 此次暂停凸显了美国加密交易所面临的严峻监管环境，合规成本和法律风险高企。这影响ABFinance用户，他们可能面临资金取用受限，也标志着美国小型交易所持续整合或关闭。 ABFinance由Helen Liu创立，她在担任Bybit联席CEO五年后离职，创办了这一旨在连接法币与加密货币的美国持牌平台。此次关闭凸显了在美国运营合规交易所需要大量资金和法律资源。
summary.en: ABFinance, a U.S. crypto exchange founded by former Bybit co-CEO Helen Liu, has suspended operations on August 14, 2025, citing U.S. regulatory pressures. The platform, which aimed to combine deposits, trading, earning, and payments, has not yet detailed the scope or timeline of the suspension. The suspension underscores the tough regulatory environment for crypto exchanges in the U.S., where compliance costs and legal risks are high. It affects ABFinance users who may face restricted access to their funds and signals continued consolidation or shutdowns among smaller U.S. exchanges. ABFinance was founded by Helen Liu, who left Bybit after five years as co-CEO, to build a U.S.-licensed platform bridging fiat and crypto. The shutdown highlights the need for significant capital and legal resources to operate a compliant exchange in the U.S.

title.zh: 苹果联手阿里巴巴在中国推出AI模型
title.en: Apple Teams With Alibaba to Debut AI Model in China

summary.zh: 苹果与阿里巴巴合作，为中国市场开发专属大语言模型；国家互联网信息办公室上个月已对苹果的生成式AI服务完成备案。预计Apple Intelligence将随iOS更新在未来数月内推送至中国iPhone，苹果可能成为首家在中国运营自有AI模型的外国公司。 这一里程碑可能标志着外国公司首次在中国运营自有AI模型，而ChatGPT和Claude等服务在中国仍被屏蔽。这也凸显了苹果转向阿里巴巴、百度和谷歌等合作伙伴的战略调整，以缩小与华为等本土竞争对手在AI方面的差距。 苹果计划将其模型与阿里巴巴的Qwen引擎及百度的技术结合使用，各系统具体分工尚不明确。此次备案扫清了一项关键监管障碍，但Siri AI仍需满足监管要求，目前在中国仍无法使用。
summary.en: Apple has partnered with Alibaba to develop a proprietary large language model for China, and the Cyberspace Administration of China registered the generative AI service last month. Apple Intelligence is expected to reach Chinese iPhones through an iOS update in the coming months, potentially making Apple the first foreign company to operate its own AI model in the country. This milestone could mark the first time a foreign company operates a proprietary AI model in China, where services like ChatGPT and Claude remain blocked. It also highlights Apple's strategic pivot to partnerships — with Alibaba, Baidu, and Google — to close the AI gap with domestic rivals such as Huawei. Apple plans to pair its model with Alibaba's Qwen engine and technology from Baidu, with the specific roles of each system still unclear. The registration clears a key regulatory hurdle, though Siri AI remains unavailable in China while it works through regulatory requirements.

title.zh: 开发者用 Codex 自动化内核优化，实现 232 倍加速
title.en: Developer Uses Codex to Automate Kernel Optimization, Achieving 232x Speedup

summary.zh: 在一篇技术博客文章中，一位开发者记录了如何使用 OpenAI 的 Codex 代理自动完成内核的研究、性能剖析、验证和优化，最终实现了 232 倍的加速。整个工作流程以“基准测试 -> 性能剖析 -> 验证 -> 研究 -> 改进”的循环自动运行。 这表明 AI 编程代理正从代码生成走向复杂的性能工程。它可能让缺乏底层专业知识的开发者也能进行内核和高性能计算优化，同时也引发了对基准过拟合的担忧。 优化循环包含验证环节以防止正确性被破坏。社区评论指出，这类 AI 驱动的优化往往对竞赛特定基准过拟合，10 个最佳方案中有 8 个在分布外输入上失败，而专家编写的方案仍然保持稳健。
summary.en: In a technical blog post, a developer documents how they used OpenAI's Codex agent to automatically research, profile, verify, and optimize a kernel, achieving a 232x speedup. The entire workflow ran in a benchmark-to-profile-to-verify-to-research-to-improve loop. This shows AI coding agents are moving beyond code generation into complex performance engineering. It could make kernel and high-performance computing optimization accessible to developers who lack deep low-level expertise, while also raising questions about benchmark overfitting. The optimization loop includes verification to prevent correctness breakage. Community comments note that such AI-driven optimizations often overfit to competition-specific benchmarks, with 8 of 10 top solutions failing on out-of-distribution inputs, whereas expert-written solutions remained robust.

title.zh: RedotPay 遭币安诉讼后搁置 10 亿美元 IPO
title.en: RedotPay Shelves $1B IPO After Binance Sues Over 470,000 Users

summary.zh: RedotPay 在币安对其提起诉讼（涉及 470,000 名用户）后，搁置了其计划的 10 亿美元首次公开募股（IPO）。这场法律纠纷打乱了这家总部位于香港的加密支付公司的上市计划。 这两家大型加密实体之间的法律冲突凸显了加密支付公司面临的法律和监管风险日益增加。这可能会削弱用户信任，并增加加密金融科技公司寻求公开上市的难度。 据报道，该诉讼涉及 470,000 名用户，但具体指控尚未公开披露。RedotPay 成立于 2023 年 4 月，专注于基于稳定币的数字资产与法定货币之间的支付转换。
summary.en: RedotPay has shelved its planned $1 billion initial public offering after Binance filed a lawsuit against the company involving 470,000 users. The legal dispute has derailed the Hong Kong-based crypto payment firm's public listing plans. This legal clash between two major crypto entities highlights the increasing legal and regulatory risks facing crypto payment companies. It could undermine user trust and make it harder for crypto fintech firms to pursue public listings. The lawsuit reportedly involves 470,000 users, though specific allegations have not been publicly detailed. RedotPay was founded in April 2023 and specializes in stablecoin-based payment conversions between digital assets and fiat currencies.

title.zh: 瑞银IBIT看涨期权敞口二季度激增24倍
title.en: UBS's IBIT Call Option Exposure Surges 24-Fold in Q2

summary.zh: 瑞银报告称，其持有贝莱德iShares比特币信托（IBIT）的看涨期权敞口在二季度环比增长超过24倍，截至6月30日达到195万股标的股份。直接持有的IBIT股份增加12%至407,890股，而看跌期权敞口则减少约53%至143,300股标的股份。 这一动向表明，机构对比特币ETF及相关衍生品的采纳正在增加，一家全球大型银行正在扩大其在数字资产领域的影响力。这一趋势可能鼓励其他大型金融机构跟进，进一步将加密货币融入主流金融体系。 该监管申报文件未披露行权价或到期日，因此仅凭文件无法判断瑞银的净方向性敞口。这次增加可能源于客户主动交易、做市商对冲、做市活动、客户全权委托组合或自营敞口；此外，其直接持有的IBIT股份仍低于2025年底报告的548,614股。
summary.en: UBS reported a more than 24-fold quarterly increase in call option exposure to BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT), reaching 1.95 million underlying shares as of June 30. Direct IBIT holdings rose 12% to 407,890 shares, while put option exposure dropped roughly 53% to 143,300 underlying shares. This signals growing institutional adoption of Bitcoin ETFs and related derivatives, with a major global bank expanding its footprint in digital assets. The trend could encourage other large financial institutions to follow suit, further integrating crypto into mainstream finance. The regulatory filing does not disclose strike prices or expiration dates, making it impossible to determine UBS's net directional exposure from the filing alone. The increase could stem from client initiatives, dealer hedging, market-making, discretionary client portfolios, or proprietary exposure, and the bank's direct IBIT holdings remain below the 548,614 shares reported at the end of 2025.

title.zh: Stacks Satoshi硬分叉推动质押STX达3.92亿
title.en: Stacks' Satoshi Hardfork Raises Staked STX to 392M

summary.zh: Stacks网络上的Satoshi硬分叉已将STX质押总量提升至3.92亿，标志着这一比特币二层网络的一个重要里程碑。该升级现已生效，并提高了参与者的承诺度。 此次升级增强了Stacks的安全性，并表明基于比特币的智能合约和质押机制正获得更多采用。作为领先的比特币二层网络，Stacks的成功可能影响更广泛的比特币DeFi生态。 该硬分叉对应Stacks的Nakamoto升级，带来了更高的交易吞吐量和100%的比特币最终性。Stacks上的质押称为“Stacking”，采用转移证明（PoX）共识机制，并以BTC奖励参与者。
summary.en: The Satoshi hardfork on the Stacks network has increased the total amount of staked STX to 392 million, marking a major milestone for the Bitcoin Layer-2 network. The upgrade is now live and has boosted participant commitment. This upgrade strengthens Stacks' security and signals growing adoption of Bitcoin-based smart contracts and staking mechanisms. As a leading Bitcoin L2, Stacks' success could influence the broader Bitcoin DeFi ecosystem. The hardfork, which corresponds to Stacks' Nakamoto upgrade, brings increased transaction throughput and 100% Bitcoin finality. Staking on Stacks, known as 'Stacking,' uses the Proof of Transfer (PoX) consensus and rewards participants in BTC.

title.zh: 2026年112亿美元融资标志着加密货币无需许可时代的终结
title.en: 2026's $11.2B Funding Signals End of Crypto's Permissionless Era

summary.zh: 一项对2026年上半年所有加密货币交易的分析发现，112亿美元资金绝大多数流向了受监管公司，投资者包括贝莱德和高盛。该研究显示，机构资本正引导行业远离无需许可的网络。 这种转变标志着加密货币市场的机构化，合规与监管成为获得资本的前提。它可能重塑竞争格局，使受监管的中介机构比开放、无需许可的协议更具优势。 这些数据由驻迪拜的加密货币律师Irina Heaver及其团队编制，他们分析了2026年上半年每一笔加密货币交易。除美国大型金融机构外，波斯湾主权财富基金也参与其中。
summary.en: An analysis of all crypto deals in H1 2026 found that $11.2 billion in funding went overwhelmingly to regulated firms, with investors including BlackRock and Goldman Sachs. The research suggests institutional capital is now steering the industry away from permissionless networks. This shift signals the institutionalization of crypto markets, where compliance and regulation become prerequisites for capital. It could reshape the competitive landscape, favoring regulated intermediaries over open, permissionless protocols. The data was compiled by Dubai-based crypto lawyer Irina Heaver and her team, who parsed every crypto deal in the first half of 2026. Persian Gulf sovereign wealth funds also participated alongside major US financial institutions.

title.zh: 加密周报：Clarity法案幸存，Strategy减持，Mastercard 18亿收购
title.en: Crypto Week: Clarity Act Survives, Strategy Sells, Mastercard's $1.8B Deal

summary.zh: 本周综述要点包括：Clarity法案在错过参议院8月窗口后幸存；Strategy出售1,690枚比特币，筹资6.53亿美元；Mastercard以18亿美元收购BVNK；以及一次硬件钱包安全恐慌导致数十亿美元比特币转移。 这些新闻凸显了加密行业正迈入一个更加规范化、机构化的时代：美国立法者仍在博弈市场结构立法，而华尔街在加深对数字资产的参与。这些动态既表明主流采用度在提升，也提醒人们数字资产仍伴随波动与安全风险。 Clarity法案在休会前未能进入程序性投票，但将在9月再次表决；同时SEC推迟了针对代币化证券的“创新豁免”。Strategy今年已累计五次出售约7,000枚比特币；Metaplanet转移了约3.2亿美元比特币，但其CEO否认在出售；Mastercard的交易是传统支付网络对加密基础设施最大的收购案，超过了Stripe以11亿美元收购Bridge的交易。
summary.en: This week's roundup covers the Clarity Act surviving after missing the Senate's August window, Strategy selling 1,690 bitcoin for $653 million, and Mastercard's $1.8 billion acquisition of BVNK, alongside a hardware-wallet security scare that moved billions in bitcoin. The news highlights crypto's transition into a more regulated, institutionalized era, with U.S. lawmakers still negotiating market-structure legislation while Wall Street deepens exposure. These developments signal both growing mainstream adoption and the continuing volatility and security risks of digital assets. The Clarity Act will get another vote in September after failing to reach a procedural vote before recess, while the SEC delayed an 'innovation exemption' for tokenized securities. Strategy has now sold roughly 7,000 bitcoin in five sales this year, and Metaplanet moved about $320 million in bitcoin, though its CEO denied any sale; Mastercard's deal is the largest crypto-infrastructure purchase by a traditional payment network, surpassing Stripe's $1.1 billion Bridge acquisition.

title.zh: Bybit将TradFi永续合约扩展至200多个全球股票与Pre-IPO资产
title.en: Bybit Expands TradFi Perpetuals to 200+ Global Equities and Pre-IPO Assets

summary.zh: Bybit已将其TradFi永续合约产品扩展到200多个全球股票和Pre-IPO资产，提供24/7交易。此次扩展基于该产品2026年4月的推出，并包含每周新增上市。 这一举措使加密货币交易所用户无需在不同时区和司法管辖区建立多个经纪关系，即可直接接触传统金融市场。它也凸显了加密衍生品与传统资产类别之间日益融合的趋势，可能吸引更广泛的交易者。 TradFi永续合约是以USDT计价和结算的衍生品，追踪传统金融资产价格，通过资金费率机制代替固定到期日。产品线包括黄金、白银、原油等大宗商品，以及美股、全球ETF和Pre-IPO资产——投资者可获得价格敞口，但不涉及股票交割或股东权利。
summary.en: Bybit has expanded its TradFi Perpetuals product to cover more than 200 global equities and pre-IPO assets with 24/7 trading. The expansion builds on the product's April 2026 launch and includes new weekly listings. This move gives crypto exchange users direct access to traditional finance markets without requiring multiple brokerage relationships across different time zones. It also highlights the growing convergence between crypto derivatives and conventional asset classes, potentially attracting a broader set of traders. TradFi Perpetuals are USDT-denominated and USDT-settled derivatives that track the prices of traditional financial assets, using a funding rate mechanism instead of a fixed expiry. The lineup includes commodities like gold, silver, and crude oil, along with US stocks, global ETFs, and pre-IPO assets, where traders gain price exposure without share delivery or shareholder rights.

title.zh: Cboe 将上线杠杆加密产品，包含 3 倍做多
title.en: Cboe to List Leveraged Crypto Products, Including 3x Long

summary.zh: 币安发文强调，Cboe 正在推进上线杠杆加密产品，不只是 1 倍现货敞口，而是 3 倍做多敞口。这一消息表明 Cboe 正在扩展其加密衍生品产品线，超越传统现货敞口。 这标志着受监管的加密衍生品领域的重要扩张，为交易者在传统交易所框架内提供了更多杠杆敞口工具。它可能通过提供主流投资者熟悉的加密产品来加速机构采用。 杠杆 ETF 通常利用互换和每日再平衡来实现标的指数每日表现的倍数（如 3 倍），并且专为短期交易设计。
summary.en: Binance highlighted that Cboe has been moving to list leveraged crypto products, not just 1x spot exposure but 3x long exposure. The announcement indicates Cboe is expanding its crypto derivatives offerings beyond traditional spot exposure. This marks a notable expansion of regulated crypto derivatives, giving traders more tools for leveraged exposure within a traditional exchange framework. It could accelerate institutional adoption by offering crypto products that are familiar to mainstream investors. Leveraged ETFs typically use swaps and daily rebalancing to deliver a multiple (such as 3x) of the underlying index's daily performance, and are intended for short-term trading.

title.zh: Bybit超越Coinbase，成为第二大加密货币交易所
title.en: Bybit Overtakes Coinbase as Second-Largest Crypto Exchange

summary.zh: 据Yellow.com报道，Bybit已超越Coinbase，成为按交易量计算的第二大加密货币交易所。这一变化被归因于Binance持续面临的监管问题，促使部分用户转向其他平台。 顶级交易所排名的重新洗牌标志着市场结构性变化，交易者越来越多地从面临监管压力的交易所分散风险。这也凸显了Binance的法律纠纷对整个加密货币交易生态的竞争性影响。 该报道未提供具体交易量数据或排名变化的确切日期。Coinbase降至第三位表明，专注于衍生品和现货交易的交易所正在激烈争夺市场份额。
summary.en: Bybit has overtaken Coinbase to become the second-largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, according to Yellow.com. The shift is attributed to ongoing regulatory troubles at Binance, which have driven users to alternative platforms. This reshuffling of top exchange rankings signals a meaningful change in market structure, as traders increasingly diversify away from exchanges under regulatory pressure. It also highlights the competitive impact of Binance's legal battles on the broader crypto trading ecosystem. The report does not provide specific trading volume figures or the exact date of the ranking change. Coinbase dropping to third place suggests that both derivatives-focused and spot-focused exchanges are competing fiercely for market share.

title.zh: 萦绕 Unicode 的幽灵字符：来历不明的中日韩汉字
title.en: Unicode's Ghost Characters: CJK Codepoints With No Known Origin

summary.zh: 保罗·麦卡恩（Paul McCann）在《A spectre is haunting Unicode》一文中剖析了幽灵字符，即 Unicode 中来源和含义均无法考证的 CJK 码位。他展示了 JIS 标准与 Unicode 的 CJK 统一过程各自产生了一批这样的幻影字形，并阐述了它们所引发的哲学与实践问题。 幽灵字符已经被纳入 Unicode 等国际标准，修改或删除它们会引发兼容性问题，但保留它们又会损害标准的严谨性。这关系到所有使用 Unicode 或依赖中日韩文字的人，因为它展示了一旦进入标准，编码错误将变得多么难以逆转。 文章指出，JIS 标准中的幽灵字符全部进入了 Unicode，而 Unicode 的 CJK 统一过程又产生了自己的一套。文章还谈到这些字符一旦被标准化便几乎不可能移除。
summary.en: In the essay "A spectre is haunting Unicode," Paul McCann examines ghost characters—CJK codepoints in Unicode that have no verifiable origin or meaning. He shows that the JIS standards and the Unicode CJK unification process each produced their own set of these phantom glyphs, and he outlines the philosophical and practical issues they raise. Ghost characters are already embedded in international standards such as Unicode, so removing or changing them would create compatibility problems, yet keeping them compromises the standard's integrity. This matters to anyone who builds on Unicode or relies on CJK text, because it shows how irreversible encoding errors can become. The article notes that ghost characters from the JIS standards all made their way into Unicode, and that Unicode's CJK unification introduced its own separate set. It also addresses why these characters are nearly impossible to remove once standardized.

title.zh: 华盛顿州法院命令Kalshi停止大部分预测市场合约
title.en: Kalshi Ordered to Halt Most Prediction Markets in Washington

summary.zh: 华盛顿州一名法官命令Kalshi停止在该州提供大范围的事件合约，驳回了该公司关于联邦商品法优先于华盛顿博彩法的论点。初步禁令要求在8月19日前实施基于IP地址和居住地的地理围栏，并在9月2日前部署GeoComply多源地理围栏系统。 这对Kalshi乃至整个预测市场行业来说是一次重大的监管挫折，表明州博彩法可以对受CFTC监管的交易所执行。这可能鼓励其他州实施类似限制，从而限制美国用户访问事件合约的地区。 金县高等法院法官John McHale禁止了与体育、选举、政治、娱乐、文化、科技、科学以及“提及”相关的合约，但豁免了商品、气候、经济和金融类合约。华盛顿上诉法院驳回了Kalshi暂缓执行禁令的请求，裁决认定《商品交易法》不优先于州博彩法。
summary.en: A Washington state judge ordered Kalshi to stop offering a broad range of event contracts in the state, rejecting the company's argument that federal commodities law preempts Washington gambling law. The preliminary injunction requires IP-address and residency-based geofencing by Aug. 19 and a GeoComply multi-source geofencing system by Sept. 2. This is a significant regulatory setback for Kalshi and the broader prediction-market industry, as it shows state gambling laws can be enforced against CFTC-regulated exchanges. It could encourage other states to impose similar restrictions, limiting where US users can access event contracts. King County Superior Court Judge John McHale barred contracts tied to sports, elections, politics, entertainment, culture, tech, science, and 'mentions,' while exempting commodities, climate, economics, and finance. The Washington Court of Appeals denied Kalshi's request to stay the injunction, and the ruling cites the Commodity Exchange Act as not preempting state gambling law.
